text:
olivia: quick sync about heatmap legend + sampling presets on dashboard. spotted a few things during usability testing: legend swatches are tiny on touch devices, p95 tooltip only shows absolute ms (no delta to baseline), and the sampling presets feel hidden under a kebab. recording + notes: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/heatmap-legend :mag:
jon: thanks. i can take legend sizing and tooltip copy. proposal: 44px min touch target for swatches, show `p95: 234ms (+12% vs baseline)` and add a `Compare to` dropdown in tooltip.
maya: a11y flag 1121 12 - color contrast of faint cells fails AA when overlay is enabled. need stronger color stops or patterned fill option for colorblind mode. also tooltips should be reachable via keyboard focus on each cell.
sam: pattern fills good idea. for screen readers we should expose each cell as a button with accessible name: "bucket 100-200ms, count 42, p95 180ms". avoid reading every cell by default; only on focus. add aria-hidden on decorative cells.
reza: perf note: the heatmap is canvas-based. making each cell a DOM button is heavy. compromise: keep canvas, but on keyboard nav create an offscreen live region and expose current cell info. implement a lightweight focus layer with SVG rects for keyboard hit testing, or reuse an invisible grid.
olivia: mobile placement for sampling presets? instead of kebab, how about a compact segmented control beneath timepicker with presets: Auto, 1%, 5%, 10%, 100%? visible but small.
jon: if we add segmented control, ensure it's tabbable and has aria-pressed states. also add keyboard shortcut `S` to open sampling menu; use `aria-keyshortcuts="S"` and announce in help overlay.
maya: microcopy: change `Auto` 12 to `Adaptive` and helper: `Automatically adjust sample to preserve tail fidelity`. keeps it clear.
sam: tooltip copy draft: "p95: 234 ms (▲12% vs baseline). Click to compare range." use up/down arrows icons for delta. also add `aria-live="polite"` to announce deltas when focus moves.
reza: implementation detail: avoid full re-render when switching presets. just swap lookup table and animate opacity on canvas overlay with `will-change: opacity` to avoid layout thrash. keep animations short (150ms).
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist generated: "legend contrast >= 4.5:1", "touch targets >= 44px", "keyboard focus for heatmap cells via focus layer", "aria-keyshortcuts for sampling menu", "tooltip aria-live for delta updates". file: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/checks/234
olivia: owners: jon (tooltip + segmented control), reza (canvas perf + opacity transitions), sam (screen reader strings + focus layer approach), maya (contrast + patterns). i'll open parent issue and link mocks. final acceptance: mobile touch targets corrected, p95 tooltip shows delta, sampling presets visible and keyboardable, no measurable jank when toggling presets.
jon: i'll add an e2e that tabs to heatmap, arrow-keys to move focus cell-to-cell, press S to open sampling, choose 5% and assert p95 tooltip delta appears.
sam: i'll vet NVDA + VO after PR.
olivia: thanks team 12 closing for async work, will follow up in the issue with mock links and tokenized copy. :sparkles:
